        "contents": "const nodeComponents = {\n, // 推广策略节点\n};\n\nconst NodePage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { nodeType } = useParams&lt;{ nodeType: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [aiRole, setAiRole] = useState&lt;AIRoleConfig | null&gt;(null);\n  const [rolesLoading, setRolesLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [roleError, setRoleError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&gt;(null);\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  // 获取节点信息 - 将URL中的连字符转换为下划线\n  const nodeId = nodeType ? nodeType.replace(/-/g, \"_\") : null;\n  const node = nodeId ? getNodeById(nodeId) : null;\n  const NodeComponent = node\n    ? nodeComponents[node.type as keyof typeof nodeComponents]\n    : null;\n\n  // 加载公开页面配置（如果存在）\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!nodeType) {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        setConfigLoading(true);\n        // 尝试根据地址查找配置\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(nodeType);\n        if (configData &amp;&amp; configData.config) {\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\n          \n          // 如果配置中有角色，使用第一个角色\n          if (configData.roles &amp;&amp; configData.roles.length &gt; 0) {\n            const firstRole = configData.roles[0];\n            setAiRole({\n              ...firstRole,\n              createdAt: new Date(firstRole.createdAt),\n              updatedAt: new Date(firstRole.updatedAt),\n            });\n            setRolesLoading(false);\n            return;\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.log('未找到公开页面配置，使用默认方式加载:', error);\n      } finally {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadPublicConfig();\n  }, [nodeType]);\n\n  // 加载AI角色配置（如果没有从公开配置中获取）\n  useEffect\n\n;",

        "contents": "const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\n 'field-mapping-management'\n];\n\n/**\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\n */\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { address } = useParams&lt;{ address: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&gt;(null);\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  // 加载公开页面配置\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!address) {\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        setConfigLoading(true);\n        setError(null);\n        // 根据地址查找配置\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\n        if (configData &amp;&amp; configData.config) {\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\n        } else {\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\n        }\n      } catch (err: any) {\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\n          navigate('/');\n          return;\n        }\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\n      } finally {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadPublicConfig();\n  }, [address, navigate]);\n\n  // 处理节点执行\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\n;\n;",

        "contents": ";\n}\n\n/**\n * 公开访问聊天页面（只读模式）\n * 通过token从配置中加载角色，隐藏配置和管理功能\n */\nconst PublicChatPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { token } = useParams&lt;{ token: string }&gt;();\n  const [roles, setRoles] = useState&lt;AIRoleConfig[]&gt;([]);\n  const [openWindows, setOpenWindows] = useState&lt;OpenChatWindow[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [activeSidebar, setActiveSidebar] = useState(true);\n  const [config, setConfig] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&gt;(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (token) {\n      loadPublicConfig(token);\n    } else {\n      setError('无效的访问令牌或配置ID');\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [token]);\n\n  // 加载公开配置（支持token和configId两种方式）\n  const loadPublicConfig = async (identifier: string) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      // 先尝试作为token加载，如果失败则作为configId加载\n      let data;\n      try {\n        data = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfig(identifier);\n      } catch (err) {\n        // 如果token方式失败，尝试作为configId\n        data = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigById(identifier);\n      }\n      \n      setConfig(data);\n      \n      // 将角色列表转换为AIRoleConfig格式\n      const formattedRoles = data.roles.map((role: any) =&gt; ({\n        ...role,\n        createdAt: new Date(role.createdAt),\n        updatedAt: new Date(role.updatedAt),\n      }));\n      setRoles(formattedRoles);\n      setError(null);\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\n      setError(err.message || '加载配置失败，请检查访问链接');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 打开聊天窗口\n  const handleOpenChat = (role: AIRoleConfig) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const PublicKnowledgePage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 加载文件列表\n  const loadFiles = async (categoryId?: number | null) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles(categoryId);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setFiles(response.data);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '加载文件失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载文件失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载文件失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 初始加载\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadCategories();\n    loadFiles();\n  }, []);\n\n  // 当选择分类改变时，重新加载文件\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadFiles(selectedCategoryId);\n  }, [selectedCategoryId]);\n\n  // 创建分类\n  const handleCreateCategory = async (data: CreateCategoryDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.createCategory(data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('分类创建成功');\n        await loadCategories();\n        setShowCategoryForm(false);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '创建分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('创建分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('创建分类失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 更新分类\n  const handleUpdateCategory = async (id: number, data: UpdateCategoryDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.updateCategory(id, data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('分类更新成功');\n        await loadCategories();\n        setEditingCategory(null);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '更新分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('更新分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('更新分类失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 删除分类\n  const handleDeleteCategory = async (id: number) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const FileList: React.FC&lt;FileListProps&gt; = ({\n  files,\n  selectedCategoryId,\n  onDeleteFile,\n  loading,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState&lt;'grid' | 'list'&gt;('grid');\n  const [previewFile, setPreviewFile] = useState&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile | null&gt;(null);\n\n  /**\n   * 修复文件名编码（前端双重保障）\n   * 处理 UTF-8 被误读为 Latin-1 的情况\n   */\n  const fixFileNameEncoding = (fileName: string): string =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 检测是否包含乱码字符\n      const hasGarbledChars = /ã|å|ä|è|ç|æ|Ã|â|€|¥/.test(fileName);\n      \n      if (hasGarbledChars) {\n        // 尝试修复编码：将字符串按 Latin-1 编码为字节，然后按 UTF-8 解码\n        // 在浏览器中，我们需要使用 TextEncoder/TextDecoder 或手动转换\n        let fixed = fileName;\n        try {\n          // 方法1: 使用 TextDecoder（推荐）\n          const encoder = new TextEncoder();\n          const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');\n          \n          // 将字符串按 Latin-1 编码（每个字符一个字节）\n          const latin1Bytes = new Uint8Array(fileName.length);\n          for (let i = 0; i &lt; fileName.length; i++) {\n            latin1Bytes[i] = fileName.charCodeAt(i) &amp; 0xFF;\n          }\n          \n          // 按 UTF-8 解码\n          fixed = decoder.decode(latin1Bytes);\n          \n          // 验证修复后的字符串是否更合理\n          const hasChinese = /[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/.test(fixed);\n          const originalPrintable = (fileName.match(/[\\x20-\\x7E\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g) || []).length;\n          const fixedPrintable = (fixed.match(/[\\x20-\\x7E\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g) || []).length;\n          const isMoreReadable = fixedPrintable &gt; originalPrintable;\n          \n          if (hasChinese || isMoreReadable) {\n            return fixed;\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          console.warn('文件名编码修复失败', e);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.warn('文件名编码修复异常', e);\n    }\n    return fileName;\n  };\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number)\n;\n;",

        },
        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      try {\n        const cleanupApi = await import(\"../../services/api\");\n        await cleanupApi.default.delete('/ai-search/files/garbled/cleanup');\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn('清理乱码文件失败:', error);\n      }\n\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\n      const files = await aiSearchService.getFiles({ pageType: effectivePageType });\n      const fileSources: Source[] = files.map((file) =&gt; ({\n        id: &#96;file_${file.id || file.fileId}&#96;,\n        title: file.name,\n        type: 'external' as const,\n        url: file.url,\n        description: &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(file.size)}&#96;,\n      }));\n      \n      setSources((prev) =&gt; {\n        const nonFileSources = prev.filter((s) =&gt; !s.id.startsWith('file_'));\n        return [...nonFileSources, ...fileSources];\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载文件列表失败:', error);\n    }\n  }, [effectivePageType]);\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\n  };\n\n  const loadAvailableWorkflows = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(true);\n      const list = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\n      setAvailableWorkflows(list);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"加载工作流列表失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"加载工作流列表失败\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n    } finally {\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [reportError]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadAvailableWorkflows();\n  }, [loadAvailableWorkflows]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadEnabledToolsForPage = async () =&gt;\n;\n  }\n;",

tabFromUrl \\n    : 'featured';\\n  \\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&amp;lt;TabType&amp;gt;(initialTab);\\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&amp;lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&amp;gt;('recent');\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n\\n  // 当 URL 参数变化时，更新 activeTab\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\\n    if (tabFromUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; tabFromUrl !== activeTab) {\\n      setActiveTab(tabFromUrl);\\n    }\\n  }, [searchParams]);\\n\\n  // 加载数据\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadProjects();\\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\\n\\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 加载精选项目\\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; featuredResponse.data) {\\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载最近项目\\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; recentResponse.data) {\\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\\\"全部\\\"和\\\"我的项目\\\"标签，或强制加载时）\\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 100,\\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\\n        });\\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; allResponse.data) {\\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\\n    if (response.success) {\\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\\\"我的项目\\\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\\n      setActiveTab('my');\\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\\n      await loadProjects(true);\\n    } else {\\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 更新最后打开时间\\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\\n    navigate(&amp;#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&amp;#96;);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    e.stopPropagation();\\n    // TODO: 实现项目菜单（编辑、删除等）\\n    console.log('Project menu clicked:', project);\\n  };\\n\\n  const getDisplayProjects = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    switch (activeTab) {\\n      case 'featured':\\n        return featuredProjects;\\n      case 'my':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      case 'all':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      default:\\n        return [];\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      {/* 顶部导航栏 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-40\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 左侧标签页 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('all');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'all' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'all'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                全部\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('my');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'my' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'my'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                我的项目\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('featured');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'featured' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'featured'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                精选项目\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; navigate('/public-knowledge')}\\n                className=\\\"px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                公共知识库\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 右侧操作栏 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 全局搜索 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"relative\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;Search className=\\\"h-4 w-4 text-gray-400\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;input\\n                  type=\\\"text\\\"\\n                  placeholder=\\\"全局搜索...\\\"\\n                  onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                    // TODO: 实现全局搜索功能\\n                    console.log('全局搜索被点击');\\n                  }}\\n                  className=\\\"pl-10 pr-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 rounded-md hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent w-48\\\"\\n                /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n              {/* 视图切换 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center border border-gray-300 rounded-md\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;button className=\\\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;List className=\\\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-600\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;button className=\\\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 border-l border-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;Grid className=\\\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-600\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n              {/* 排序 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"relative\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;button className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 rounded-md hover:bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;最近&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;ChevronDown className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n              {/* Agent助手按钮 */}\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; setUserMenuOpen(!userMenuOpen)}\\n                  className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200\\\"\\n                  title=\\\"用户\\\"\\n                &amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;User className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;用户&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;ChevronDown className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 transition-transform duration-200 ${userMenuOpen ? (\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-center py-12\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600\\\"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        ) : (\\n          &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n            {activeTab === 'featured' ? (\\n              &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;FeaturedProjectList\\n                  projects={featuredProjects}\\n                  onProjectClick={handleProjectClick}\\n                /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;RecentProjectList\\n                  projects={recentProjects}\\n                  onProjectClick={handleProjectClick}\\n                  onNewProjectClick={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)}\\n                  onProjectMenuClick={handleProjectMenuClick}\\n                /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n            ) : (\\n              &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h2 className=\\\"text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {activeTab === 'all' ? '全部项目' : '我的项目'}\\n                &amp;lt;/h2&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;NewProjectCard onClick={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)} /&amp;gt;\\n                  {getDisplayProjects().map((project) =&amp;gt; (\\n                    &amp;lt;ProjectCard\\n                      key={project.id}\\n                      project={project}\\n                      onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleProjectClick(project)}\\n                      onMenuClick={(e) =&amp;gt; handleProjectMenuClick(e, project)}\\n                    /&amp;gt;\\n                  ))}\\n                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            )}\\n          &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n        )}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n      {/* 新建项目对话框 */}\\n      &amp;lt;NewProjectModal\\n        isOpen={isNewProjectModalOpen}\\n        onClose={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(false)}\\n        onSubmit={handleCreateProject}\\n      /&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default HomePage;\\n\","

tabFromUrl \\n    : 'featured';\\n  \\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&amp;lt;TabType&amp;gt;(initialTab);\\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&amp;lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&amp;gt;('recent');\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n\\n  // 当 URL 参数变化时，更新 activeTab\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\\n    if (tabFromUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; tabFromUrl !== activeTab) {\\n      setActiveTab(tabFromUrl);\\n    }\\n  }, [searchParams]);\\n\\n  // 加载数据\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadProjects();\\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\\n\\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 加载精选项目\\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; featuredResponse.data) {\\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载最近项目\\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; recentResponse.data) {\\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\\\"全部\\\"和\\\"我的项目\\\"标签，或强制加载时）\\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 100,\\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\\n        });\\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; allResponse.data) {\\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\\n    if (response.success) {\\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\\\"我的项目\\\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\\n      setActiveTab('my');\\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\\n      await loadProjects(true);\\n    } else {\\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 更新最后打开时间\\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\\n    navigate(&amp;#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&amp;#96;);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    e.stopPropagation();\\n    // TODO: 实现项目菜单（编辑、删除等）\\n    console.log('Project menu clicked:', project);\\n  };\\n\\n  const getDisplayProjects = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    switch (activeTab) {\\n      case 'featured':\\n        return featuredProjects;\\n      case 'my':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      case 'all':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      default:\\n        return [];\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      {/* 顶部导航栏 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-40\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 左侧标签页 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('all');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'all' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'all'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                全部\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('my');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'my' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'my'\\n                    ? useState(false);\\n  const [showUploadModal, setShowUploadModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [editingCategory, setEditingCategory] = useState&amp;lt;CategoryTreeNode | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [showCategoryForm, setShowCategoryForm] = useState(false);\\n\\n  // 加载分类树\\n  const loadCategories = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getCategoryTree();\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setCategories(response.data);\\n      } else {\\n        toast.error(response.message || '加载分类失败');\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载分类失败:', error);\\n      toast.error('加载分类失败');\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 加载文件列表\\n  const loadFiles = async (categoryId?: number | null) =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles(categoryId);\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setFiles(response.data);\\n      } else {\\n        toast.error(response.message || '加载文件失败');\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载文件失败:', error);\\n      toast.error('加载文件失败');\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 初始加载\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadCategories();\\n    loadFiles();\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 当选择分类改变时，重新加载文件\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadFiles(selectedCategoryId);\\n  }, [selectedCategoryId]);\\n\\n  // 创建分类\\n  const handleCreateCategory = async (data: CreateCategoryDTO) =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.createCategory(data);\\n      if (response.success) {\\n        toast.success('分类创建成功');\\n        await loadCategories();\\n        setShowCategoryForm(false);\\n      } else {\\n        toast.error(response.message || '创建分类失败');\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('创建分类失败:', error);\\n      toast.error('创建分类失败');\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 更新分类\\n  const handleUpdateCategory = async (id: number, data: UpdateCategoryDTO) =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.updateCategory(id, data);\\n      if (response.success)                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import express from 'express';\\nimport dotenv from 'dotenv';\\nimport cors from 'cors';\\nimport path from 'path';\\nimport apiRoutes from './routes';\\nimport difyProxyRoutes from './routes/dify-proxy';\\nimport { testConnection } from './config/database';\\nimport { publicPageConfigModel, aiRoleModel } from './models';\\nimport { logger } from './shared/lib/logger';\\nimport { errorTracking } from './shared/infrastructure/monitoring/errorTracking';\\nimport { SourceInformationService } from './services/sourceInformationService';\\n\\n// 导入监控模块\\nimport { performanceMonitor as _performanceMonitor } from './shared/infrastructure/monitoring/performanceMonitor';\\nimport { prometheusMetrics as _prometheusMetrics } from './shared/infrastructure/monitoring/prometheusMetrics';\\n\\n// 确保模块正确加载\\nconst performanceMonitor = _performanceMonitor || null;\\nconst prometheusMetrics = _prometheusMetrics || null;\\n\\ndotenv.config();\\n\\nconst app = express();\\nconst port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3003;\\n\\n// 初始化错误追踪\\nerrorTracking.init();\\n\\n// 中间件\\napp.use(cors());\\napp.use(express.json());\\n\\n// 性能监控中间件（放在最前面）\\nif (performanceMonitor &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof performanceMonitor.middleware === 'function') {\\n  app.use(performanceMonitor.middleware());\\n} else {\\n  logger.warn('性能监控中间件未正确加载，跳过');\\n}\\n\\n// Prometheus 指标中间件（放在性能监控之后）\\nif (prometheusMetrics &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof prometheusMetrics.middleware === 'function') {\\n  app.use(prometheusMetrics.middleware());\\n} else {\\n  logger.warn('Prometheus 指标中间件未正确加载，跳过');\\n}\\n\\n// 添加请求日志中间件（放在最前面，但要在路由之前）\\napp.use((req, res, next) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();\\n  logger.info('收到请求', {\\n    timestamp,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    ip: req.ip || req.connection.remoteAddress,\\n    userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'),\\n    body: req.body,\\n    authorization: req.get('Authorization')?.substring(0, 20),\\n    contentType: req.get('Content-Type'),\\n  });\\n  next();\\n});\\n\\n// API 路由必须放在静态文件服务之前\\n// 路由配置（API 保持 /api/v1 前缀）\\napp.use('/api/v1', apiRoutes);\\n\\n// Dify API 代理路由\\napp.use('/api/dify', difyProxyRoutes);\\n\\n// 公开访问接口（通过token获取配置和角色）\\napp.get('/api/v1/public/:token', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { token } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAccessToken(token);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取角色列表\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\n      if (workflow) {\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\\n      context: { metadata: { token: req.params.token } },\\n    });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\\n      data: null\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 公开访问接口（通过address获取配置和角色）\\napp.get('/api/v1/public-by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { address } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAddress(address);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取角色列表\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; JSON.parse(workflow.nodes) \\n            : workflow.nodes;\\n          if (Array.isArray(workflowNodes)) {\\n            const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n            const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n            roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n          }\\n        } catch (parseError) {\\n          logger.warn('解析工作流节点失败', { \\n            workflowId: config.workflowId, \\n            error: parseError \\n          });\\n          // 解析失败时返回空角色列表，不抛出错误\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'role' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));\\n    res.status(500).send('# Error generating metrics\\\\n');\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 公共知识库文件服务\\nconst publicKnowledgeUploadDir = path.join(__dirname, '../uploads/public-knowledge');\\napp.use('/api/v1/public-knowledge/files', express.static(publicKnowledgeUploadDir, {\\n  maxAge: 86400000, // 1 day\\n  etag: true,\\n  lastModified: true,\\n}));\\n\\n// 生产环境静态文件服务：直接从 frontend/dist 提供资源\\n// 注意：必须在 API 路由之后，否则会拦截 API 请求\\n// 仅在非开发环境或明确需要时才启用静态文件服务\\nconst isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';\\nif (!isDev) {\\n  const distDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../frontend/dist');\\n  app.use(express.static(distDir, {\\n    maxAge: 0,\\n    etag: true,\\n    lastModified: true,\\n  }));\\n\\n  // SPA Fallback：除 /api/* 外的所有路由都返回 index.html\\n  app.get(/^(\\\\/(?!api).*)$/, (_req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n    res.sendFile(path.join(distDir, 'index.html'));\\n  });\\n}\\n\\n// 全局错误处理中间件\\n// 注意：这个中间件必须放在所有路由之后，且必须有4个参数 (err, req, res, next)\\napp.use((err: any, req: any, res: any, next: any) =&amp;gt; {\\n  // 如果响应已经发送，则委托给默认的 Express 错误处理\\n  if (res.headersSent) {\\n    return next(err);\\n  }\\n\\n  // 记录错误详情\\n  logger.error('全局错误处理', {\\n    error: err,\\n    stack: err?.stack,\\n    requestUrl: req.url,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    path: req.path,\\n    body: req.body,\\n    params: req.params,\\n    query: req.query,\\n  });\\n\\n  // 发送到错误追踪\\n  errorTracking.captureException(\\n    err instanceof Error ?                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { publicKnowledgeModel } from '../models';\\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\\nimport fs from 'fs';\\nimport path from 'path';\\nimport { CreateFileDTO, UpdateFileDTO, CreateCategoryDTO, UpdateCategoryDTO } from '../models/PublicKnowledge';\\n\\nexport class PublicKnowledgeService {\\n  private uploadDir: string;\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    // 设置上传目录\\n    this.uploadDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'backend', 'uploads', 'public-knowledge');\\n    this.ensureUploadDir();\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 确保上传目录存在\\n   */\\n  private ensureUploadDir(): void {\\n    if (!fs.existsSync(this.uploadDir)) {\\n      fs.mkdirSync(this.uploadDir, { recursive: true });\\n      logger.info(&amp;#96;创建上传目录: ${this.uploadDir}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取上传目录路径\\n   */\\n  getUploadDir(): string {\\n    return this.uploadDir;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 生成文件存储路径\\n   */\\n  generateFilePath(originalName: string): string {\\n    const timestamp = Date.now();\\n    const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);\\n    const ext = path.extname(originalName);\\n    const baseName = path.basename(originalName, ext);\\n    const sanitizedName = baseName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\\\\u4e00-\\\\u9fa5]/g, '_');\\n    const fileName = &amp;#96;${timestamp}-${randomStr}-${sanitizedName}${ext}&amp;#96;;\\n    return path.join(this.uploadDir, fileName);\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件的相对URL路径\\n   */\\n  getFileUrl(filePath: string): string {\\n    const relativePath = path.relative(path.join(process.cwd(), 'backend'), filePath);\\n    return &amp;#96;/api/v1/public-knowledge/files/${path.basename(filePath)}&amp;#96;;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 保存上传的文件\\n   */\\n  async saveUploadedFile(file: Express.Multer.File, categoryId?: number | null, description?: string, uploadedBy?: number): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const filePath = this.generateFilePath(file.originalname);\\n      \\n      // 确保目录存在\\n      const dir = path.dirname(filePath);\\n      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {\\n        fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });\\n      }\\n\\n      // 移动文件到目标位置\\n      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, file.buffer);\\n\\n      // 创建文件记录\\n      const fileData: CreateFileDTO = {\\n        category_id: categoryId ?? null,\\n        name: file.originalname,\\n        file_path: filePath,\\n        file_type: file.mimetype,\\n        file_size: file.size,\\n        description: description,\\n        uploaded_by: uploadedBy\\n      };\\n\\n      const fileRecord = await publicKnowledgeModel.createFile(fileData);\\n      \\n      logger.info('文件上传成功', {\\n        fileId: fileRecord.id,\\n        fileName: file.originalname,\\n        filePath: filePath\\n      });\\n\\n      return {\\n        ...fileRecord,\\n        file_url: this.getFileUrl(filePath)\\n      };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('保存上传文件失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除文件（包括物理文件）\\n   */\\n  async deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(fileId: number): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const file = await publicKnowledgeModel.getFileById(fileId);\\n      if (!file) {\\n        throw new Error('文件不存在');\\n      }\\n\\n      // 删除物理文件\\n      if (fs.existsSync(file.file_path)) {\\n        fs.unlinkSync(file.file_path);\\n        logger.info('物理文件已删除', { filePath: file.file_path });\\n      }\\n\\n      // 删除数据库记录\\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.deleteFile(fileId);\\n      \\n      logger.info('文件删除成功', { fileId });\\n      return true;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('删除文件失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件流\\n   */\\n  async getFileStream(fileId: number): Promise&amp;lt;{ stream: fs.ReadStream; file: any }&amp;gt; {\\n    const file = await publicKnowledgeModel.getFileById(fileId);\\n    if (!file) {\\n      throw new Error('文件不存在');\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!fs.existsSync(file.file_path)) {\\n      throw new Error('物理文件不存在');\\n    }\\n\\n    const stream = fs.createReadStream(file.file_path);\\n    return { stream, file };\\n  }\\n\\n  // ==================== 分类相关方法 ====================\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 创建分类\\n   */\\n  async createCategory(data: CreateCategoryDTO): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      return await publicKnowledgeModel.createCategory(data);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('创建分类失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取分类树\\n   */\\n  async getCategoryTree(): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      return await publicKnowledgeModel.getAllCategories();\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('获取分类列表失败:', error);\\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取分类详情\\n   */\\n  async getCategoryById(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    return this.deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(id);\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nexport const publicKnowledgeService = new PublicKnowledgeService();\\n\","

['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl)) \\\\n    ? tabFromUrl \\\\n    : 'featured';\\\\n  \\\\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&amp;amp;lt;TabType&amp;amp;gt;(initialTab);\\\\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&amp;amp;lt;Project[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&amp;amp;lt;Project[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&amp;amp;lt;Project[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&amp;amp;lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&amp;amp;gt;('recent');\\\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n\\\\n  // 当 URL 参数变化时，更新 activeTab\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    loadProjects();\\\\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\\\\n\\\\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    setIsLoading(true);\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 加载精选项目\\\\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\\\\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; featuredResponse.data) {\\\\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 加载最近项目\\\\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\\\\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\\\\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\\\\n        });\\\\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; allResponse.data) {\\\\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\\\\n    if (response.success) {\\\\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\\\\\\\"我的项目\\\\\\\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\\\\n      setActiveTab('my');\\\\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\\\\n      await loadProjects(true);\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 更新最后打开时间\\\\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\\\\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\\\\n    navigate(&amp;amp;#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    e.stopPropagation();\\\\n    // TODO: 实现项目菜单（编辑、删除等）\\\\n    console.log('Project menu clicked:', project);\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const getDisplayProjects = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    switch (activeTab) {\\\\n      case 'featured':\\\\n        return featuredProjects;\\\\n      case 'my':\\\\n        return allProjects;\\\\n      case 'all':\\\\n        return allProjects;\\\\n      default:\\\\n        return [];\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  return (\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      {/* 顶部导航栏 */}\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-40\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center justify-between h-16\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {/* 左侧标签页 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center space-x-1\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                  setActiveTab('all');\\\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'all' });\\\\n                }}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\\\n                  activeTab === 'all'\\\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\\\n                }&amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                全部\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                  setActiveTab('my');\\\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'my' });\\\\n                }}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\\\n                  activeTab === 'my'\\\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\\\n                }&amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                我的项目\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                  setActiveTab('featured');\\\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'featured' });\\\\n                }}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\\\n                  activeTab === 'featured'\\\\n                    ? navigate('/public-knowledge')}\\\\n                className=\\\\\\\"px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100\\\\\\\"\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                公共知识库\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                    // TODO: 实现全局搜索功能\\\\n                    console.log('全局搜索被点击');\\\\n                  }}\\\\n                  className=\\\\\\\"pl-10 pr-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 rounded-md hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent w-48\\\\\\\"\\\\n                /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n              {/* 视图切换 */}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center border border-gray-300 rounded-md\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;button className=\\\\\\\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;List className=\\\\\\\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-600\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;button className=\\\\\\\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 border-l border-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;Grid className=\\\\\\\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-600\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n              {/* 排序 */}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"relative\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;button className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center space-x-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 rounded-md hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;最近&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;ChevronDown className=\\\\\\\"w-4 h-4\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n              {/* Agent助手按钮 */}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; tabFromUrl \\n    : 'featured';\\n  \\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&amp;lt;TabType&amp;gt;(initialTab);\\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&amp;lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&amp;gt;('recent');\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n\\n  // 当 URL 参数变化时，更新 activeTab\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\\n    if (tabFromUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; tabFromUrl !== activeTab) {\\n      setActiveTab(tabFromUrl);\\n    }\\n  }, [searchParams]);\\n\\n  // 加载数据\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadProjects();\\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\\n\\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 加载精选项目\\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; featuredResponse.data) {\\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载最近项目\\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; recentResponse.data) {\\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\\\"全部\\\"和\\\"我的项目\\\"标签，或强制加载时）\\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 100,\\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\\n        });\\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; allResponse.data) {\\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\\n    if (response.success) {\\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\\\"我的项目\\\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\\n      setActiveTab('my');\\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\\n      await loadProjects(true);\\n    } else {\\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 更新最后打开时间\\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\\n    navigate(&amp;#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&amp;#96;);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    e.stopPropagation();\\n    // TODO: 实现项目菜单（编辑、删除等）\\n    console.log('Project menu clicked:', project);\\n  };\\n\\n  const getDisplayProjects = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    switch (activeTab) {\\n      case 'featured':\\n        return featuredProjects;\\n      case 'my':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      case 'all':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      default:\\n        return [];\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      {/* 顶部导航栏 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-40\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 左侧标签页 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('all');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'all' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'all'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                全部\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('my');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'my' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'my'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                我的项目\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('featured');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'featured' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'featured'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                精选项目\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; The current thought is to create a well-defined &amp;#96;public-knowledge-base-implementation&amp;#96; plan, as that will ensure the project gets completed efficiently.\""

                  "lineNumber": 10681,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"plan\\\": \\\"# 公共知识库 implementation plan\\\\n\\\\n## 1. 数据库设计 (Database Design)\\\\n我们将创建两个新表来管理公共知识库的分类和文件。将采用项目现有的 &amp;amp;#96;initializeTable&amp;amp;#96; 模式进行表初始化。\\\\n\\\\n### 1.1 表结构\\\\n*   **&amp;amp;#96;public_knowledge_categories&amp;amp;#96;**: 存储分类目录结构\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;id&amp;amp;#96;: BIGINT (PK)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;name&amp;amp;#96;: VARCHAR (分类名称)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;parent_id&amp;amp;#96;: BIGINT (父分类ID, 支持无限层级)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;sort_order&amp;amp;#96;: INT (排序)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;created_at&amp;amp;#96;: TIMESTAMP\\\\n*   **&amp;amp;#96;public_knowledge_files&amp;amp;#96;**: 存储文件信息\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;id&amp;amp;#96;: BIGINT (PK)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;category_id&amp;amp;#96;: BIGINT (关联分类)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;name&amp;amp;#96;: VARCHAR (文件名)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;file_path&amp;amp;#96;: VARCHAR (存储路径/URL)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;file_type&amp;amp;#96;: VARCHAR (文件类型 mime-type)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;file_size&amp;amp;#96;: BIGINT (文件大小)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;description&amp;amp;#96;: TEXT (描述)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;uploaded_by&amp;amp;#96;: BIGINT (上传者ID, 可选)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;created_at&amp;amp;#96;: TIMESTAMP\\\\n\\\\n## 2. 后端开发 (Backend Development)\\\\n*   **Model**: 创建 &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/models/PublicKnowledge.ts&amp;amp;#96;，实现 &amp;amp;#96;initializeTable&amp;amp;#96; 方法。\\\\n*   **Service**: 创建 &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/publicKnowledgeService.ts&amp;amp;#96; 处理业务逻辑（如文件上传处理、递归删除分类等）。\\\\n*   **Controller**: 创建 &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/controllers/PublicKnowledgeController.ts&amp;amp;#96; 暴露 RESTful 接口。\\\\n*   **Router**: 在 &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/routes/publicKnowledge.ts&amp;amp;#96; 定义路由，并注册到 &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/routes/index.ts&amp;amp;#96;。\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;GET /categories&amp;amp;#96;: 获取分类树\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;POST /categories&amp;amp;#96;: 创建分类\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;POST /upload&amp;amp;#96;: 上传文件 (使用 &amp;amp;#96;multer&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;GET /files&amp;amp;#96;: 获取文件列表 (支持按分类筛选)\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;DELETE /files/:id&amp;amp;#96;: 删除文件\\\\n\\\\n## 3. 前端开发 (Frontend Development)\\\\n*   **Types**: 定义 &amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/types/publicKnowledge.ts&amp;amp;#96; 类型。\\\\n*   **Service**: 创建 &amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/services/publicKnowledgeService.ts&amp;amp;#96; 调用后端 API。\\\\n*   **Pages**: 创建 &amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/PublicKnowledge/index.tsx&amp;amp;#96; 作为主页面。\\\\n*   **Components**:\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;CategorySidebar&amp;amp;#96;: 左侧分类树组件 (支持新建、重命名)。\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;FileList&amp;amp;#96;: 右侧文件列表 (Grid/List 视图)。\\\\n    *   &amp;amp;#96;UploadModal&amp;amp;#96;: 文件上传弹窗 (支持拖拽)。\\\\n\\\\n## 4. 存储策略 (Storage Strategy)\\\\n*   当前阶段使用本地存储 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/uploads/public-knowledge/&amp;amp;#96;)。\\\\n*   未来可扩展为对象存储 (S3/OSS)。\\\\n\\\\n## 5. 实施步骤 (Implementation Steps)\\\\n1.  后端：创建数据模型与数据库表。\\\\n2.  后端：实现文件上传与分类管理的 API。\\\\n3.  前端：实现 API Service 层。\\\\n4.  前端：开发分类侧边栏与文件列表页面。\\\\n5.  联调与测试。\\\",\""
                }
              ]
            },

{\\n      logger.info('SIGTERM received, shutting down gracefully');\\n      server.close(() =&amp;gt; {\\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\\n        process.exit(0);\\n      });\\n    });\\n\\n    process.on('SIGINT', () =&amp;gt; 'DESC' : 'ASC'\\n        });\\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; allResponse.data) {\\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\\n    if (response.success) {\\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\\\"我的项目\\\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\\n      setActiveTab('my');\\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\\n      await loadProjects(true);\\n    } else {\\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('all');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'all' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'all'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                全部\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('my');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'my' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'my'\\n                    ?                   "lineNumber": 2831,
                  "content": "I'm solidifying the project's roadmap now, with a strong focus on execution steps. I've broken down the implementation into clear stages: database schema design for file and category management, backend model/service/controller development, and finally, frontend UI creation. The current thought is to create a well-defined &#96;public-knowledge-base-implementation&#96; plan, as that will ensure the project gets completed efficiently."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 2847,
                  "content": "  \"plan\": \"# 公共知识库 implementation plan\\n\\n## 1. 数据库设计 (Database Design)\\n我们将创建两个新表来管理公共知识库的分类和文件。将采用项目现有的 &amp;#96;initializeTable&amp;#96; 模式进行表初始化。\\n\\n### 1.1 表结构\\n*   **&amp;#96;public_knowledge_categories&amp;#96;**: 存储分类目录结构\\n    *   &amp;#96;id&amp;#96;: BIGINT (PK)\\n    *   &amp;#96;name&amp;#96;: VARCHAR (分类名称)\\n    *   &amp;#96;parent_id&amp;#96;: BIGINT (父分类ID, 支持无限层级)\\n    *   &amp;#96;sort_order&amp;#96;: INT (排序)\\n    *   &amp;#96;created_at&amp;#96;: TIMESTAMP\\n*   **&amp;#96;public_knowledge_files&amp;#96;**: 存储文件信息\\n    *   &amp;#96;id&amp;#96;: BIGINT (PK)\\n    *   &amp;#96;category_id&amp;#96;: BIGINT (关联分类)\\n    *   &amp;#96;name&amp;#96;: VARCHAR (文件名)\\n    *   &amp;#96;file_path&amp;#96;: VARCHAR (存储路径/URL)\\n    *   &amp;#96;file_type&amp;#96;: VARCHAR (文件类型 mime-type)\\n    *   &amp;#96;file_size&amp;#96;: BIGINT (文件大小)\\n    *   &amp;#96;description&amp;#96;: TEXT (描述)\\n    *   &amp;#96;uploaded_by&amp;#96;: BIGINT (上传者ID, 可选)\\n    *   &amp;#96;created_at&amp;#96;: TIMESTAMP\\n\\n## 2. 后端开发 (Backend Development)\\n*   **Model**: 创建 &amp;#96;backend/src/models/PublicKnowledge.ts&amp;#96;，实现 &amp;#96;initializeTable&amp;#96; 方法。\\n*   **Service**: 创建 &amp;#96;backend/src/services/publicKnowledgeService.ts&amp;#96; 处理业务逻辑（如文件上传处理、递归删除分类等）。\\n*   **Controller**: 创建 &amp;#96;backend/src/controllers/PublicKnowledgeController.ts&amp;#96; 暴露 RESTful 接口。\\n*   **Router**: 在 &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/publicKnowledge.ts&amp;#96; 定义路由，并注册到 &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/index.ts&amp;#96;。\\n    *   &amp;#96;GET /categories&amp;#96;: 获取分类树\\n    *   &amp;#96;POST /categories&amp;#96;: 创建分类\\n    *   &amp;#96;POST /upload&amp;#96;: 上传文件 (使用 &amp;#96;multer&amp;#96;)\\n    *   &amp;#96;GET /files&amp;#96;: 获取文件列表 (支持按分类筛选)\\n    *   &amp;#96;DELETE /files/:id&amp;#96;: 删除文件\\n\\n## 3. 前端开发 (Frontend Development)\\n*   **Types**: 定义 &amp;#96;frontend/src/types/publicKnowledge.ts&amp;#96; 类型。\\n*   **Service**: 创建 &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/publicKnowledgeService.ts&amp;#96; 调用后端 API。\\n*   **Pages**: 创建 &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/PublicKnowledge/index.tsx&amp;#96; 作为主页面。\\n*   **Components**:\\n    *   &amp;#96;CategorySidebar&amp;#96;: 左侧分类树组件 (支持新建、重命名)。\\n    *   &amp;#96;FileList&amp;#96;: 右侧文件列表 (Grid/List 视图)。\\n    *   &amp;#96;UploadModal&amp;#96;: 文件上传弹窗 (支持拖拽)。\\n\\n## 4. 存储策略 (Storage Strategy)\\n*   当前阶段使用本地存储 (&amp;#96;backend/uploads/public-knowledge/&amp;#96;)。\\n*   未来可扩展为对象存储 (S3/OSS)。\\n\\n## 5. 实施步骤 (Implementation Steps)\\n1.  后端：创建数据模型与数据库表。\\n2.  后端：实现文件上传与分类管理的 API。\\n3.  前端：实现 API Service 层。\\n4.  前端：开发分类侧边栏与文件列表页面。\\n5.  联调与测试。\","
                },

{\n    const response = await api.get&lt;CategoryTreeNode[]&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories/tree&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有分类\n   */\n  async getAllCategories(): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory[]&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory[]&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取分类\n   */\n  async getCategoryById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 创建分类\n   */\n  async createCategory(data: CreateCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.post&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 更新分类\n   */\n  async updateCategory(id: number, data: UpdateCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 删除分类\n   */\n  async deleteCategory(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete&lt;void&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // ==================== 文件相关 ====================\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件列表\n   */\n  async getFiles(categoryId?: number | null): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&gt;&gt; {\n    const params: any = {};\n    if (categoryId !== undefined) {\n      params.category_id = categoryId === null ? 'null' : categoryId;\n    }\n    const response = await api.get&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/files&#96;, { params });\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取文件\n   */\n  async getFileById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/files/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 上传文件（支持单个或多个文件）\n   */\n  async uploadFile(\n    files: File | File[],\n    data?: CreateFileDTO\n  ): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile | PublicKnowledgeFile[]&gt;&gt; {\n    const fileArray = Array.isArray(files) ? files : [files];\n    const formData = new FormData();\n    \n    // 添加所有文件（使用 'files' 作为字段名，因为后端使用 upload.array('files')）\n    fileArray.forEach(file =&gt; {\n      formData.append('files', file);\n    });\n    \n    if (data?.category_id !== undefined) {\n      formData.append('category_id', data.category_id === null ? 'null' : String(data.category_id));\n    }\n    if (data?.description) {\n      formData.append('description', data.description);\n    }\n    if (data?.uploaded_by) {\n      formData.append('uploaded_by', String(data.uploaded_by));\n    }\n\n    // 使用 axios 直接上传，因为 api 封装可能不支持 FormData\n    const axios = (await import('axios')).default;\n    const baseURL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1';\n    const response = await axios.post&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile | PublicKnowledgeFile[]&gt;&gt;(\n      &#96;${baseURL}${BASE_URL}/upload&#96;,\n      formData,\n      {\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',\n        },\n      }\n    );\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 更新文件\n   */\n  async updateFile(id: number, data: UpdateFileDTO): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/files/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件\n   */\n  async deleteFile(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete&lt;void&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/files/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 下载文件\n   */\n  async downloadFile(id: number): Promise&lt;Blob&gt; {\n    const response = await fetch(&#96;${import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1'}${BASE_URL}/files/${id}/download&#96;);\n    if (!response.ok) {\n      throw new Error('下载文件失败');\n    }\n    return response.blob();\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件URL（用于预览）\n   * 使用文件ID而不是文件名，避免编码问题\n   */\n  getFileUrl(file: PublicKnowledgeFile): string {\n    // 优先使用文件ID构建URL，避免文件名编码问题\n    const baseURL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1';\n    return &#96;${baseURL}${BASE_URL}/files/${file.id}/preview&#96;;\n  }\n};\n",

CreateCategoryDTO, UpdateCategoryDTO } from '../models/PublicKnowledge';\n\nexport class PublicKnowledgeService {\n  private uploadDir: string;\n\n  constructor() {\n    // 设置上传目录\n    this.uploadDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'backend', 'uploads', 'public-knowledge');\n    this.ensureUploadDir();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 确保上传目录存在\n   */\n  private ensureUploadDir(): void {\n    if (!fs.existsSync(this.uploadDir)) {\n      fs.mkdirSync(this.uploadDir, { recursive: true });\n      logger.info(&#96;创建上传目录: ${this.uploadDir}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取上传目录路径\n   */\n  getUploadDir(): string {\n    return this.uploadDir;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成文件存储路径\n   */\n  generateFilePath(originalName: string): string {\n    const timestamp = Date.now();\n    const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);\n    const ext = path.extname(originalName);\n    const baseName = path.basename(originalName, ext);\n    const sanitizedName = baseName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g, '_');\n    const fileName = &#96;${timestamp}-${randomStr}-${sanitizedName}${ext}&#96;;\n    return path.join(this.uploadDir, fileName);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件的相对URL路径\n   */\n  getFileUrl(filePath: string): string {\n    const relativePath = path.relative(path.join(process.cwd(), 'backend'), filePath);\n    return &#96;/api/v1/public-knowledge/files/${path.basename(filePath)}&#96;;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 修复文件名编码（处理 UTF-8 被误读为 Latin-1 的情况）\n   */\n  private fixFileNameEncoding(originalName: string): string {\n    try {\n      // 检测是否包含乱码字符（UTF-8 被误读为 Latin-1 的典型特征）\n      // 包括：ã, å, ä, è, ç, æ, Ã, â 等常见乱码字符\n      const hasGarbledChars = /ã|å|ä|è|ç|æ|Ã|â|€|¥/.test(originalName);\n      \n      if (hasGarbledChars) {\n        // 策略1: 尝试将整个字符串按 Latin-1 编码转换为 UTF-8\n        try {\n          const buffer = Buffer.from(originalName, 'latin1');\n          const decoded = buffer.toString('utf8');\n          \n          // 验证解码后的字符串是否更合理\n          // 1. 包含中文字符（最可靠的指标）\n          const hasChinese = /[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/.test(decoded);\n          // 2. 或者解码后的字符串包含更多可打印字符（排除控制字符）\n          const originalPrintable = (originalName.match(/[\\x20-\\x7E\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g) || []).length;\n          const decodedPrintable = (decoded.match(/[\\x20-\\x7E\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g) || []).length;\n          const isMoreReadable = decodedPrintable &gt; originalPrintable;\n          // 3. 检查是否包含更少的乱码字符\n          const originalGarbled = (originalName.match(/ã|å|ä|è|ç|æ|Ã|â|€|¥/g) || []).length;\n          const decodedGarbled = (decoded.match(/ã|å|ä|è|ç|æ|Ã|â|€|¥/g) || []).length;\n          const hasLessGarbled = decodedGarbled &lt; originalGarbled;\n          \n          if (hasChinese || (isMoreReadable &amp;&amp; hasLessGarbled)) {\n            logger.info('文件名编码已修复', { \n              before: originalName, \n              after: decoded,\n              hasChinese,\n              isMoreReadable,\n              hasLessGarbled\n            });\n            return decoded;\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          logger.debug('策略1修复失败', { error: e });\n        }\n        \n        // 策略2: 如果策略1失败，尝试修复混合编码的情况\n        // 检测并修复部分乱码的字符串\n        try {\n          let fixed = originalName;\n          // 查找并修复常见的乱码模式\n          // 例如：ã【 可能是 【 被错误编码\n          fixed = fixed.replace(/ã【/g, '【');\n          fixed = fixed.replace(/】/g, '】'); // 确保】正确\n          \n          // 如果修复后包含中文字符，使用修复后的版本\n          if (/[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/.test(fixed) &amp;&amp; fixed !== originalName) {\n            logger.info('文件名编码已修复（策略2）', { \n              before: originalName, \n              after: fixed\n            });\n            return fixed;\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          logger.debug('策略2修复失败', { error: e });\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      logger.warn('文件名编码修复失败，使用原始文件名', { originalName, error: e });\n    }\n    return originalName;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 保存上传的文件\n   */\n  async saveUploadedFile(file: Express.Multer.File, categoryId?: number | null, description?: string, uploadedBy?: number): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 修复文件名编码\n      const fixedFileName = this.fixFileNameEncoding(file.originalname);\n      \n      const filePath = this.generateFilePath(fixedFileName);\n      \n      // 确保目录存在\n      const dir = path.dirname(filePath);\n      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {\n        fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });\n      }\n\n      // 移动文件到目标位置\n      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, file.buffer);\n\n      // 创建文件记录（使用修复后的文件名）\n      const fileData: CreateFileDTO = {\n        category_id: categoryId ?? null,\n        name: fixedFileName,\n        file_path: filePath,\n        file_type: file.mimetype,\n        file_size: file.size,\n        description: description,\n        uploaded_by: uploadedBy\n      };\n\n      const fileRecord = await publicKnowledgeModel.createFile(fileData);\n      \n      logger.info('文件上传成功', {\n        fileId: fileRecord.id,\n        fileName: fixedFileName,\n        filePath: filePath\n      });\n\n      return {\n        ...fileRecord,\n        file_url: this.getFileUrl(filePath)\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('保存上传文件失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件（包括物理文件）\n   */\n  async deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(fileId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try {\n      const file = await publicKnowledgeModel.getFileById(fileId);\n      if (!file) {\n        throw new Error('文件不存在');\n      }\n\n      // 删除物理文件\n      if (fs.existsSync(file.file_path)) {\n        fs.unlinkSync(file.file_path);\n        logger.info('物理文件已删除', { filePath: file.file_path });\n      }\n\n      // 删除数据库记录\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.deleteFile(fileId);\n      \n      logger.info('文件删除成功', { fileId });\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('删除文件失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件流\n   */\n  async getFileStream(fileId: number): Promise&lt;{ stream: fs.ReadStream; file: any }&gt; {\n    const file = await publicKnowledgeModel.getFileById(fileId);\n    if (!file) {\n      throw new Error('文件不存在');\n    }\n\n    if (!fs.existsSync(file.file_path)) {\n      throw new Error('物理文件不存在');\n    }\n\n    const stream = fs.createReadStream(file.file_path);\n    return { \n      stream, \n      file: {\n        ...file,\n        name: this.fixFileNameEncoding(file.name) // 修复文件名编码\n      }\n    };\n  }\n\n  // ==================== 分类相关方法 ====================\n\n  /**\n   * 创建分类\n   */\n  async createCategory(data: CreateCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      return await publicKnowledgeModel.createCategory(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('创建分类失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取分类树\n   */\n  async getCategoryTree(): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      return await publicKnowledgeModel.getCategoryTree();\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取分类树失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有分类\n   */\n  async getAllCategories(): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      return await publicKnowledgeModel.getAllCategories();\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取分类列表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取分类详情\n   */\n  async getCategoryById(id: number): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const category = await publicKnowledgeModel.getCategoryById(id);\n      if (!category) {\n        throw new Error('分类不存在');\n      }\n      return category;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取分类详情失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新分类\n   */\n  async updateCategory(id: number, data: UpdateCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const category = await publicKnowledgeModel.updateCategory(id, data);\n      if (!category) {\n        throw new Error('分类不存在');\n      }\n      return category;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('更新分类失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除分类（递归删除子分类和关联文件）\n   */\n  async deleteCategory(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 获取所有子分类\n      const children = await publicKnowledgeModel.getCategoriesByParentId(id);\n      \n      // 递归删除子分类\n      for (const child of children) {\n        await this.deleteCategory(child.id);\n      }\n\n      // 获取分类下的所有文件并删除\n      const files = await publicKnowledgeModel.getFilesByCategoryId(id);\n      for (const file of files) {\n        await this.deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(file.id);\n      }\n\n      // 删除分类本身\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.deleteCategory(id);\n      \n      logger.info('分类删除成功', { categoryId: id });\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('删除分类失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ==================== 文件相关方法 ====================\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件列表\n   */\n  async getFiles(categoryId?: number | null): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      const files = await publicKnowledgeModel.getAllFiles(categoryId);\n      return files.map(file =&gt; ({\n        ...file,\n        name: this.fixFileNameEncoding(file.name), // 修复文件名编码\n        file_url: this.getFileUrl(file.file_path)\n      }));\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件详情\n   */\n  async getFileById(id: number): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const file = await publicKnowledgeModel.getFileById(id);\n      if (!file) {\n        throw new Error('文件不存在');\n      }\n      return {\n        ...file,\n        name: this.fixFileNameEncoding(file.name), // 修复文件名编码\n        file_url: this.getFileUrl(file.file_path)\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件详情失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新文件\n   */\n  async updateFile(id: number, data: UpdateFileDTO): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const file = await publicKnowledgeModel.updateFile(id, data);\n      if (!file) {\n        throw new Error('文件不存在');\n      }\n      return {\n        ...file,\n        name: this.fixFileNameEncoding(file.name), // 修复文件名编码\n        file_url: this.getFileUrl(file.file_path)\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('更新文件失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件\n   */\n  async deleteFile(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    return this.deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(id);\n  }\n}\n\nexport const publicKnowledgeService = new PublicKnowledgeService();\n",
