        "contents": "export class TechCategoryModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取分类树结构\n   */\n  async getTree(): Promise&lt;TechCategory[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \n      WHERE status = ? \n      ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC, name ASC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ACTIVE]);\n    const categories = result as TechCategory[];\n    \n    // 构建树结构\n    const categoryMap = new Map&lt;number, TechCategory &amp; { children?: TechCategory[] }&gt;();\n    const rootCategories: (TechCategory &amp; { children?: TechCategory[] })[] = [];\n\n    // 初始化所有分类\n    categories.forEach(category =&gt; {\n      categoryMap.set(category.id, { ...category, children: [] });\n    });\n\n    // 构建父子关系\n    categories.forEach(category =&gt; {\n      const categoryWithChildren = categoryMap.get(category.id)!;\n      \n      if (category.parent_id === null) {\n        rootCategories.push(categoryWithChildren);\n      } else {\n        const parent = categoryMap.get(category.parent_id!);\n        if (parent) {\n          parent.children!.push(categoryWithChildren);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    return rootCategories;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新技术分类\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;TechCategory | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点树结构\n   */\n  async getTree(categoryId?: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint[]&gt; {\n    let sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \n      WHERE status = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const values: any[] = [Status.ACTIVE];\n\n    if (categoryId) {\n      sql += ' AND category_id = ?';\n      values.push(categoryId);\n    }\n\n    sql += ' ORDER BY level ASC, priority DESC, created_at DESC';\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const techPoints = result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\n    \n    // 构建树结构\n    const techPointMap = new Map&lt;number, TechPoint &amp; { children?: TechPoint[] }&gt;();\n    const rootTechPoints: (TechPoint &amp; { children?: TechPoint[] })[] = [];\n\n    // 初始化所有技术点\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&gt; {\n      techPointMap.set(techPoint.id, { ...techPoint, children: [] });\n    });\n\n    // 构建父子关系\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&gt; {\n      const techPointWithChildren = techPointMap.get(techPoint.id)!;\n      \n      if (techPoint.parent_id === null) {\n        rootTechPoints.push(techPointWithChildren);\n      } else {\n        const parent = techPointMap.get(techPoint.parent_id!);\n        if (parent) {\n          parent.children!.push(techPointWithChildren);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    return rootTechPoints;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新技术点\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 删除分类（递归删除子分类和关联文件）\n   */\n  async deleteCategory(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 获取所有子分类\n      const children = await publicKnowledgeModel.getCategoriesByParentId(id);\n      \n      // 递归删除子分类\n      for (const child of children) {\n        await this.deleteCategory(child.id);\n      }\n\n      // 获取分类下的所有文件并删除\n      const files = await publicKnowledgeModel.getFilesByCategoryId(id);\n      for (const file of files) {\n        await this.deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(file.id);\n      }\n\n      // 删除分类本身\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.deleteCategory(id);\n      \n      logger.info('分类删除成功', { categoryId: id });\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('删除分类失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ==================== 文件相关方法 ====================\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件列表\n   */\n  async getFiles(categoryId?: number | null): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

' WHERE category_id IS NULL' : ' WHERE category_id IS NULL';\n      } else {\n        // 获取指定分类及其所有子分类的ID\n        const allCategoryIds = await this.getAllDescendantCategoryIds(categoryId);\n        \n        // 构建 IN 查询\n        if (allCategoryIds.length === 1) {\n          sql += dbType === 'sqlite' ? undefined \n        : category_id === 'null' || category_id === null \n          ? null \n          : parseInt(category_id as string);\n\n      const files = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles(categoryId);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: files\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取文件列表失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件详情\n   */\n  async getFileById(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的文件ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const file = await publicKnowledgeService.getFileById(id);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: file\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件详情失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取文件详情失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 上传文件（支持单个或多个文件）\n   */\n  async uploadFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const uploadMiddleware = upload.array('files', 50); // 最多支持50个文件\n      \n      uploadMiddleware(req, res, async (err) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          logger.error('文件上传失败:', err);\n          return res.status(400).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: err.message || '文件上传失败'\n          });\n        }\n\n        const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n        if (!files || files.length === 0) {\n          return res.status(400).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: '未选择文件'\n          });\n        }\n\n        try {\n          const { category_id, description, uploaded_by } = req.body;\n          const categoryId = category_id !== undefined \n            ? (category_id === 'null' || category_id === null ? null : parseInt(category_id))\n            : undefined;\n          const uploadedBy = uploaded_by ? parseInt(uploaded_by) : undefined;\n\n          // 批量上传文件\n          const uploadResults = await Promise.all(\n            files.map(file =&gt; \n              publicKnowledgeService.saveUploadedFile(\n                file,\n                categoryId,\n                description, // 所有文件共享同一个描述\n                uploadedBy\n              )\n            )\n          );\n\n          res.status(201).json({\n            success: true,\n            data: uploadResults.length === 1 ? uploadResults[0] : uploadResults,\n            message: uploadResults.length === 1 \n              ? '文件上传成功' \n              : &#96;成功上传 ${uploadResults.length} 个文件&#96;\n          });\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error('保存文件失败:', error);\n          res.status(500).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '保存文件失败'\n          });\n        }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('上传文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '上传文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新文件\n   */\n  async updateFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的文件ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const { category_id, name, description } = req.body;\n\n      const file = await publicKnowledgeService.updateFile(id, {\n        category_id: category_id !== undefined \n          ? (category_id === 'null' || category_id === null ? null : parseInt(category_id))\n          : undefined,\n        name,\n        description\n      });\n\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: file,\n        message: '文件更新成功'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('更新文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件\n   */\n  async deleteFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的文件ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      await publicKnowledgeService.deleteFile(id);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        message: '文件删除成功'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('删除文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '删除文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 下载文件\n   */\n  async downloadFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的文件ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const { stream, file } = await publicKnowledgeService.getFileStream(id);\n\n      res.setHeader('Content-Type', file.file_type);\n      res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', &#96;attachment; filename=\"${encodeURIComponent(file.name)}\"&#96;);\n      res.setHeader('Content-Length', file.file_size);\n\n      stream.pipe(res);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('下载文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '下载文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 预览文件（通过文件ID）\n   */\n  async previewFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的文件ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const { stream, file } = await publicKnowledgeService.getFileStream(id);\n\n      // 设置响应头\n      res.setHeader('Content-Type', file.file_type);\n      res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', &#96;inline; filename=\"${encodeURIComponent(file.name)}\"&#96;);\n      res.setHeader('Content-Length', file.file_size);\n      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=86400'); // 缓存1天\n\n      stream.pipe(res);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('预览文件失败:', error);\n      const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : '预览文件失败';\n      const statusCode = errorMessage.includes('不存在') ? 404 : 500;\n      res.status(statusCode).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: errorMessage\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件（用于直接访问）\n   * 注意：这个路由实际上由静态文件服务处理，但保留作为备用\n   */\n  async getFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const filename = req.params.filename;\n      const filePath = require('path').join(publicKnowledgeService.getUploadDir(), filename);\n\n      if (!require('fs').existsSync(filePath)) {\n        return res.status(404).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '文件不存在'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const fileStream = require('fs').createReadStream(filePath);\n      fileStream.pipe(res);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const publicKnowledgeController = new PublicKnowledgeController();\n",

' WHERE category_id IS NULL' : ' WHERE category_id IS NULL';\n      } else {\n        // 获取指定分类及其所有子分类的ID\n        const allCategoryIds = await this.getAllDescendantCategoryIds(categoryId);\n        \n        // 构建 IN 查询\n        if (allCategoryIds.length === 1) {\n          sql += dbType === 'sqlite' ? 1. **递归获取子分类ID**：新增 `getAllDescendantCategoryIds`，递归获取指定分类的所有子分类ID
2. **修改文件获取逻辑**：更新 `getAllFiles`，当指定 `categoryId` 时，获取该分类及其所有子分类的文件

现在的行为：
- 未选择分类（`categoryId` 为 `undefined`）：显示所有文件
- 选择分类（`categoryId` 为数字）：显示该分类及其所有子分类的文件
- 选择"未分类"（`categoryId` 为 `null`）：仅显示没有分类的文件

刷新页面 `http://localhost:3001/public-knowledge`，选择分类后将看到该分类及其所有子分类中的文件。

        "contents": "const PublicKnowledgePage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 加载文件列表\n  const loadFiles = async (categoryId?: number | null) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles(categoryId);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setFiles(response.data);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '加载文件失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载文件失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载文件失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 初始加载\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadCategories();\n    loadFiles();\n  }, []);\n\n  // 当选择分类改变时，重新加载文件\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadFiles(selectedCategoryId);\n  }, [selectedCategoryId]);\n\n  // 创建分类\n  const handleCreateCategory = async (data: CreateCategoryDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.createCategory(data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('分类创建成功');\n        await loadCategories();\n        setShowCategoryForm(false);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '创建分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('创建分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('创建分类失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 更新分类\n  const handleUpdateCategory = async (id: number, data: UpdateCategoryDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.updateCategory(id, data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('分类更新成功');\n        await loadCategories();\n        setEditingCategory(null);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '更新分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('更新分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('更新分类失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 删除分类\n  const handleDeleteCategory = async (id: number) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 过滤检索信息：排除上传的文件，只显示真正的检索信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\n  const filteredSources = sources.filter(source =&gt; {\n    // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的，不是http链接）\n    if (source.url &amp;&amp; !source.url.startsWith('http') &amp;&amp; !source.url.startsWith('https')) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    // 只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源\n    return true;\n  }).filter(source =&gt;\n    source.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||\n    source.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const filteredTechPoints = techPoints.filter(tp =&gt;\n    tp.name.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\n    tp.description?.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const filteredKnowledgePoints = knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&gt;\n    kp.title.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\n    kp.content?.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const filteredPublicFiles = publicKnowledgeFiles.filter(file =&gt;\n    file.name.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\n    file.description?.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const toggleTechPoint = (techPointId: number) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedTechPoints(prev =&gt;\n      prev.includes(techPointId)\n        ? prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== techPointId)\n        : [...prev, techPointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const toggleKnowledgePoint = (knowledgePointId: number) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedKnowledgePoints(prev =&gt;\n      prev.includes(knowledgePointId)\n        ? prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== knowledgePointId)\n        : [...prev, knowledgePointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const togglePublicFile = async (fileId: number)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\nconst ;\n    const publicKnowledgeAsPoints: KnowledgePoint[] = publicKnowledgeSources.map(source =&gt; ({\n      id: source.id,\n      tech_point_id: 0, // 公共知识库文件没有关联的技术点\n      title: source.title,\n      content: source.description || '',\n      knowledge_type: 'fact' as any,\n      difficulty_level: 'intermediate' as any,\n      tags: [],\n      prerequisites: [],\n      learning_objectives: [],\n      examples: [],\n      references: [],\n      status: 'active' as any,\n      created_at: source.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),\n      updated_at: source.created_at || new Date().toISOString()\n    }));\n    \n    // 合并技术点关联的知识点和公共知识库文件\n    const allKnowledgePoints = [\n      ...knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&gt; selectedKnowledgePoints.includes(kp.id)),\n      ...publicKnowledgeAsPoints\n    ];\n    \n    console.log('[资源清单] 更新配置资源:', {\n      文件数量: files.length,\n      互联网信息数量: internetInfo.length,\n      技术点数量: techPoints.filter(tp =&gt; selectedTechPoints.includes(tp.id)).length,\n      知识点数量: allKnowledgePoints.length,\n      公共知识库文件数量: publicKnowledgeAsPoints.length,\n      总来源数量: sources.length,\n      文件列表: files.map(f =&gt; ({ id: f.id, title: f.title, url: f.url }))\n    });\n    \n    setConfiguredResources({\n      files: files,\n      internetInfo: internetInfo,\n      techPoints: techPoints.filter(tp =&gt; selectedTechPoints.includes(tp.id)),\n      knowledgePoints: allKnowledgePoints\n    });\n  }, [sources, selectedTechPoints, selectedKnowledgePoints, techPoints, knowledgePoints]);\n\n  const loadProject = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    try {\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setProject(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadSources = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst toggleKnowledgePoint = \nprev =&gt;\n [...prev, knowledgePointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const togglePublicFile = async (fileId: number) =&gt; {\n    if (selectedPublicFiles.includes(fileId)) {\n      // 取消选择：从selectedPublicFiles中移除，并从项目中删除对应的来源\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(prev =&gt; prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== fileId));\n      if (projectId) {\n        // 查找对应的来源信息并删除\n        const sourceToDelete = sources.find(s =&gt; \n          s.type === 'knowledge_base' &amp;&amp; \n          s.source_id === &#96;public_kb_${fileId}&#96;\n        );\n        if (sourceToDelete) {\n          try {\n            await handleDeleteSource(sourceToDelete.id);\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('删除公共知识库文件来源失败:', error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      // 选择：添加到selectedPublicFiles，并添加到项目来源中\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(prev =&gt; [...prev, fileId]);\n      if (projectId) {\n        const file = publicKnowledgeFiles.find(f =&gt; f.id === fileId);\n        if (file) {\n          try {\n            await api.post('/source-information', {\n              source_id: &#96;public_kb_${file.id}&#96;,\n              title: file.name,\n              type: 'knowledge_base',\n              url: file.file_url || file.file_path,\n              description: file.description || &#96;公共知识库文件: ${file.name}&#96;,\n              page_type: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n              conversation_id: null\n            });\n            // 重新加载来源列表\n            await loadSources();\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('添加公共知识库文件到项目失败:', error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleTechnicalTranslation = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async \n\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\"检索信息\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\n      // 检查：type为external，且有url，且url不是http/https开头\n      // 文件URL特征：以/uploads/开头，或者包含文件扩展名（.pdf, .doc等）\n      \n      // 首先检查type\n      if (s.type !== 'external') {\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      // 检查URL是否存在\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;&amp; (typeof s.url === 'string' || typeof s.url === 'object');\n      if (!hasUrl) {\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（无URL）:', { \n          id: s.id, \n          title: s.title, \n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          urlType: typeof s.url\n        });\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      // 处理URL（可能是字符串或对象）\n      let urlStr: string;\n      if (typeof s.url === 'string') {\n        urlStr = s.url.trim();\n      } else if (s.url &amp;&amp; typeof s.url === 'object' &amp;&amp; 'toString' in s.url) {\n        urlStr = String(s.url).trim();\n      } else {\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（URL格式异常）:', { \n          id: s.id, \n          title: s.title, \n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          urlType: typeof s.url\n        });\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      if (urlStr.length === 0) {\n        return false;\n      }\n    };\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n  const [aiConversationId, setAiConversationId] = useState&lt;string | undefined&gt;(undefined);\n  const [savedConversationSourceId, setSavedConversationSourceId] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null); // 已保存的对话来源ID\n  const aiMessagesEndRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);\n  \n  // 提炼为技术点相关状态\n  const [extractingTechPoint, setExtractingTechPoint] = useState(false);\n  const [showTechPointPreview, setShowTechPointPreview] = useState(false);\n  const [extractedTechPointData, setExtractedTechPointData] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [extractingSourceId, setExtractingSourceId] = useState&lt;number | null&gt;(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (projectId) {\n      loadProject();\n      loadSources();\n      loadTechPoints();\n      loadPublicKnowledgeFiles();\n      checkHistoryRecords(); // 检查历史记录\n    }\n  }, [projectId]);\n\n  // 处理从技术点库页面返回的选中技术点\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const selectedTechPointIds = searchParams.get('selectedTechPointIds');\n    if (selectedTechPointIds) {\n      try {\n        const ids = selectedTechPointIds.split(',').map(id =&gt; parseInt(id, 10)).filter(id =&gt; !isNaN(id));\n        if (ids.length &gt; 0) {\n          setSelectedTechPoints(ids);\n          // 重新加载技术点列表，确保能获取到完整的技术点信息\n          loadTechPoints();\n          // 清除URL参数\n          const newSearchParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);\n          newSearchParams.delete('selectedTechPointIds');\n          setSearchParams(newSearchParams, { replace: true });\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('解析选中技术点ID失败:', error);\n      }\n    }\n  }, [searchParams, setSearchParams]);\n\n  // AI消息自动滚动到底部\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    aiMessagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n  }, [aiMessages]);\n\n  // AI问答发送消息\n  const handleAISendMessage = async ()\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n    \n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;&amp; typeof s.url === 'string' &amp;&amp; s.url.trim().length &gt; 0;\n      if (!hasUrl) {\n        // 没有URL的文本来源，需要检查是否是对话摘要或技术转译\n        const category = getCategory(s);\n        if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\n          return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\n        }\n        return true; // 没有URL且不是对话摘要/技术转译的，归类为互联网信息\n      }\n      \n      const urlStr = s.url.trim();\n      const isHttpUrl = urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://');\n      const isFileUrl = !isHttpUrl &amp;&amp; (\n        urlStr.startsWith('/uploads/') || \n        urlStr.startsWith('uploads/') ||\n        /\\.(pdf|doc|docx|txt|md|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|ppt|pptx)$/i.test(urlStr)\n      );\n      \n      if (isFileUrl) {\n        return false; // 排除文件\n      }\n      \n      // 排除对话摘要和技术转译（这些应该显示在历史记录中，而不是互联网信息点）\n      const category = getCategory(s);\n      if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\n        return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\n      }\n      \n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\n      return true;\n    });\n    \n    // 将公共知识库文件（type: 'knowledge_base'）转换为知识点格式\n    const publicKnowledgeSources = sources.filter(s =&gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\n    const publicKnowledgeAsPoints: KnowledgePoint[] = publicKnowledgeSources.map(source =&gt; ({\n      id: source.id,\n      tech_point_id: 0,\n);\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 同步已添加的公共知识库文件到selectedPublicFiles\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (sources.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; publicKnowledgeFiles.length &gt; 0) {\n      const addedFileIds: number[] = [];\n      sources.forEach(source =&gt; {\n        if (source.type === 'knowledge_base' &amp;&amp; source.source_id.startsWith('public_kb_')) {\n          const fileId = parseInt(source.source_id.replace('public_kb_', ''));\n          if (!isNaN(fileId) &amp;&amp; publicKnowledgeFiles.find(f =&gt; f.id === fileId)) {\n            addedFileIds.push(fileId);\n          }\n        }\n      });\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(addedFileIds);\n    }\n  }, [sources, publicKnowledgeFiles]);\n\n  // 点击外部关闭下拉菜单\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n      if (techPointSelectorRef.current &amp;&amp; !techPointSelectorRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {\n        setShowTechPointSelector(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\n    return () =&gt; {\n      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleFileUpload = async (files: FileList | null) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const HomePage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();\n  \n  // 从 URL 参数中读取标签页，如果没有则默认为 'featured'\n  const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\n  const initialTab: TabType = (tabFromUrl &amp;&amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl)) \n    ? tabFromUrl \n    : 'featured';\n  \n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&lt;TabType&gt;(initialTab);\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&gt;('recent');\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  // 当 URL 参数变化时，更新 activeTab\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\n    if (tabFromUrl &amp;&amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl) &amp;&amp; tabFromUrl !== activeTab) {\n      setActiveTab(tabFromUrl);\n    }\n  }, [searchParams]);\n\n  // 加载数据\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadProjects();\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\n\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const HomePage: React.FC = \n;\n\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 加载精选项目\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;&amp; featuredResponse.data) {\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载最近项目\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;&amp; recentResponse.data) {\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\"全部\"和\"我的项目\"标签，或强制加载时）\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100,\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\n        });\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;&amp; allResponse.data) {\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&gt; {\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\n    if (response.success) {\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\"我的项目\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\n      setActiveTab('my');\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\n      await loadProjects(true);\n    } else {\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&gt; {\n    // 更新最后打开时间\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\n    navigate(&#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&#96;);\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project)\n;\n;",

{\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const [categories, setCategories] = useState&lt;CategoryTreeNode[]&gt;([]);\n  const [files, setFiles] = useState&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&gt;([]);\n  const [selectedCategoryId, setSelectedCategoryId] = useState&lt;number | null&gt;(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [showUploadModal, setShowUploadModal] = useState(false);\n  const [editingCategory, setEditingCategory] = useState&lt;CategoryTreeNode | null&gt;(null);\n  const [showCategoryForm, setShowCategoryForm] = useState(false);\n\n  // 加载分类树\n  const loadCategories = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getCategoryTree();\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setCategories(response.data);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '加载分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载分类失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 加载文件列表\n  const loadFiles = async (categoryId?: number | null) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles(categoryId);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setFiles(response.data);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '加载文件失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载文件失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载文件失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 初始加载\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadCategories();\n    loadFiles();\n  }, []);\n\n  // 当选择分类改变时，重新加载文件\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadFiles(selectedCategoryId);\n  }, [selectedCategoryId]);\n\n  // 创建分类\n  const handleCreateCategory = async (data: CreateCategoryDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.updateCategory(id, data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('分类更新成功');\n        await loadCategories();\n        setEditingCategory(null);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '更新分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('更新分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('更新分类失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 删除分类\n  const handleDeleteCategory = async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('确定要删除这个分类吗？删除后，该分类下的所有子分类和文件也将被删除。')) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.deleteCategory(id);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('分类删除成功');\n        await loadCategories();\n        if (selectedCategoryId === id) {\n          setSelectedCategoryId(null);\n        }\n        await loadFiles(selectedCategoryId === id ? null : selectedCategoryId);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '删除分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('删除分类失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 上传文件\n  const handleUploadFile = async (file: File, data?: CreateFileDTO) =&gt;
